SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Uses of body parts • Mouth • Eyes • Legs • Hands • Ears together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: sharing as learner plays signed games mentioning uses of body parts

● Peace: compassion as learner news tells using signs on the uses of body parts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Human sexuality: Basic parts of the body- learners recognize the signs for external body parts.

Link to other learning areas: The learner is able to relate the signs for external body parts as they learn about creation in religious
